lead.headline: Coinbase Pivots Toward Financial Super-App via RWA Integration
lead.tldr: Coinbase's move into 1:1 tokenized US stocks signals a strategic shift from a pure exchange to a comprehensive financial super-app, bridging the gap between traditional equities and on-chain rails.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Coinbase launching tokenized US stocks, backed 1:1, with holders able to receive dividends
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is launching tokenized US stocks that are backed 1:1 by the underlying assets. This initiative allows holders to receive dividends, positioning Coinbase against rivals like Robinhood and Kraken in the RWA space.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The inclusion of dividends in tokenized stocks removes a primary friction point for institutional adoption of RWAs.

top_signals.title: 코인베이스도 “금융 슈퍼앱” 선언, 암호화폐 거래소의 피벗 열풍
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is pivoting toward becoming a 'financial super-app' by launching 1:1 tokenized US stocks on its own on-chain rails. This strategy aims to integrate traditional assets with crypto and payments, distinguishing itself from Binance's indirect brokerage approach by emphasizing direct ownership and regulatory compliance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Coinbase is leveraging regulatory compliance as a competitive moat to capture the 'super-app' market share from less transparent rivals.

top_signals.title: Australia's High Court backs regulator in Block Earner crypto yield case
top_signals.summary: Australia's High Court has unanimously ruled that Block Earner was required to hold a financial services licence for its crypto yield operations. This decision overturns a previous appeal and reinforces the regulator's authority over crypto-asset service providers in the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Australian High Court's ruling underscores the increasing global trend of treating crypto yield as a regulated financial service.

top_signals.title: BitGo Launches MiCA Crypto Infrastructure In Europe
top_signals.summary: BitGo has launched a crypto-as-a-service platform in Europe designed to be compliant with the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation. The platform provides regulated custody and trading tools to help firms meet the EU's upcoming regulatory deadlines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BitGo's MiCA-compliant infrastructure provides a blueprint for institutional entry into the EU market ahead of regulatory deadlines.

top_signals.title: Senate, House reach agreement on housing bill banning CBDC through 2030
top_signals.summary: The US Senate and House have reached an agreement on housing legislation that includes a ban on the issuance of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) through 2030. This legislative move signals a significant regulatory hurdle for the potential implementation of a digital dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A US legislative ban on CBDCs through 2030 creates a vacuum that private stablecoin issuers are well-positioned to fill.

deals.summary: MANTRA is being acquired by its previous backer, Inveniam, following a period of instability. The acquisition follows a major collapse of MANTRA's token value in 2025, leading to company restructuring and layoffs.

Trace Finance has raised $32 million in a funding round led by Coinfund to expand its stablecoin settlement infrastructure. The company aims to facilitate cross-border digital asset transfers as payment firms and policymakers increase their focus on the sector.

EarnOS has launched Ero, an application designed to verify human internet traffic and combat AI-generated 'slop' and bot activity. The project aims to reward authentic digital behavior while helping brands reduce waste caused by automated traffic.

Miami-based startup Karta has raised $15 million to launch a WhatsApp-integrated premium credit card service for global travelers. The product aims to provide non-U.S. clients with access to U.S. credit cards, filling a gap left by previous American Express offerings.

on_the_radar.title: Illinois governor approves crypto transaction tax despite industry uproar“There is effectively no comparable state financial transaction tax on stocks, bonds or derivatives anywhere in the country,” said a16z general counsel Miles Jennings.
on_the_radar.summary: The Governor of Illinois has approved a tax on cryptocurrency transactions, sparking significant backlash from the industry. Critics, including a16z, argue that the tax is discriminatory as no similar transaction tax exists for traditional financial assets like stocks or bonds.

on_the_radar.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial nears OCC approval for federal trust charter: report
on_the_radar.summary: World Liberty Financial, a project backed by Donald Trump, is reportedly close to receiving a federal trust charter from the OCC. This approval would enable the entity to issue and redeem its USD1 stablecoin under a single federal regulator.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase unveils 'System Update' unlocking an AI advisor, global unified liquidity, options trading and more
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has announced a major 'System Update' introducing an AI-powered advisor and a unified liquidity pool for global trading. The update also expands the platform's offerings to include options trading and enhanced user experience features.

on_the_radar.title: State Street, Anchorage Back Fund for Stablecoin Reserves
on_the_radar.summary: State Street Investment Management has launched a new money market fund specifically designed for stablecoin issuers to manage their reserve assets. This move follows similar initiatives by other major financial institutions like JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley, signaling growing institutional adoption of stablecoin infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: ‘Biggest spend of the cycle:’ Fairshake crypto PAC’s pick Barry Moore wins Alabama GOP Senate primary
on_the_radar.summary: Rep. Barry Moore won the Alabama GOP Senate primary after receiving significant financial support from Fairshake, a crypto-funded super PAC. This victory highlights the growing influence of the digital asset industry in shaping U.S. political leadership.

on_the_radar.title: Coinmena, Revolut Expand Uae Financial Services Footprint
on_the_radar.summary: CoinMENA has partnered with Standard Chartered to enhance its fiat infrastructure in the UAE. Simultaneously, Revolut is reportedly securing payment licenses to facilitate its official launch in the region.

on_the_radar.title: 'He had his day in court:' Sens. Lummis and Gallego press Trump not to pardon former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried
on_the_radar.summary: Senators Lummis and Gallego have urged Donald Trump to refrain from granting a pardon to former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried. The lawmakers emphasize that Bankman-Fried should serve his sentence following his conviction for fraud and conspiracy.

on_the_radar.title: China pays closer attention to stablecoins as cross-border role expands24m, China pays closer attention to stablecoins as cross-border role expandsA senior PBOC official called for closer monitoring, stronger regulation and international coordination as stablecoins gain importance in global payments.
on_the_radar.summary: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) is increasing its focus on stablecoins due to their growing role in cross-border payments. A senior official has called for enhanced monitoring, stricter regulation, and international cooperation to manage these assets.

linkedin_post:
Coinbase is no longer just an exchange; it is aggressively pivoting toward a 'financial super-app.' By launching 1:1 tokenized US stocks with dividend support on its own on-chain rails, Coinbase is attempting to collapse the wall between TradFi and DeFi.

This isn't just about new product lines—it's a strategic play for ownership of the entire financial stack. While others offer indirect brokerage, Coinbase is betting on direct ownership and regulatory compliance to win the RWA race. Simultaneously, we see a tightening regulatory environment in Australia and a legislative freeze on US CBDCs, further cementing the role of private, compliant infrastructure as the primary bridge for institutional capital.

As the lines between brokerage, banking, and blockchain blur, will the 'super-app' model become the only viable path for scale in Web3?
